about_the_game:
Welcome to the sweetest puzzle game!

Candy magic is an easy to learn but incredibly deep game where your goal is to create chain reactions and score maximum points before the box is filled to the brim.

Throw the candies into the box and watch them obey the laws of physics.

Your main task is to match the same candies. When two candies of the same level collide, they turn into one candy of a higher level — bigger, more beautiful and more valuable!

Tactical bonuses to help!

When things go badly, special bonuses come to the rescue. Use them wisely to get out of a desperate situation and create an epic combination!

  • Shake - shake the box well and all the candies inside will mix. It's ideal to pile up disparate pairs and clear the space.

  • The exchanger is the magic of chance! Activate this bonus, and all the candies in the box will instantly swap places in random order. You never know what a great combination you'll get as a result!

  • A bomb - throw it right into the thick of the action! After the explosion, she destroys all the surrounding candies, clearing a decent piece of the field.

  • The diminisher - magically lowers the level of ALL the candies on the field. The big candies get smaller, freeing up precious space and giving you a second chance.

Key Features:

  • Addictive gameplay: The ease of control hides a deep tactical component. Every throw counts;

  • Chain reactions: Enjoy spectacular cascades of mergers, when one combination triggers a series of transformations.;

  • Strategic use of bonuses: A properly selected bonus at the right moment can save a losing game and bring a record number of points.;

  • The pleasure of progress: The feeling of satisfaction when you create a huge, sparkling candy of the maximum level is incomparable.;

  • Perfect for relaxation: Soothing graphics and pleasant sounds will help you relax after a long day;

  • 15 challenging levels.

Are you ready to test your strategy and reaction? Add "Candy Collapse" to your wish list and get ready for sweet chaos!
